meta.title: Star-Hopping
meta.subTitle: Star-Hopping
meta.desc: Train visual spatial intuition for coordinates, distances, proportions, and rotations using polar and bipolar perspective grids.

star_single.title: Single Anchor
star_single.desc: Single central anchor to evaluate polar angle and distance estimation.
star_single.instruction: Observe the target relative to the central anchor on the left, then locate it in the grid on the right.

star_double_h.title: Horizontal Double Anchors
star_double_h.desc: Horizontal dual anchors to train proportion and orthogonal projection intuition.
star_double_h.instruction: Observe the relationship between horizontal dual anchors on the left, then locate the target on the right.

star_double_r.title: Rotated Double Anchors
star_double_r.desc: Tilted dual anchors to master complex rotated coordinate mapping.
star_double_r.instruction: Observe the rotated dual anchors on the left, then locate the target on the right.

spatialBias.title: Spatial Bias Analysis
spatialBias.subTitle: Center point represents ground truth. Point spread reveals systematic hand-eye offset.
spatialBias.desc: Center is the ground truth. Tighter cluster indicates sharper spatial intuition.

directionalCompass.title: 8-Directional Sensitivity
directionalCompass.subTitle: Insights into your localization accuracy across 8 polar sectors
directionalCompass.needMoreTrials: Complete at least 3 trials in each sector to generate blindspot diagnostics.
